name: matt77-inbound
description: Matt77 inbound Lambda — authorizes Telegram senders against DynamoDB and forwards authorized updates (messages and callback queries) onto the outbound SQS FIFO queue.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist ./matt77-inbound.zip && rollup --config rollup.config.js --entryFileNames "[name].mjs" && zip -j ./matt77-inbound.zip dist/*
